subject: Quiet-hour latency escalation — evidence & retention questions
messages:
From: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@cardinalbank.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.ops@cardinalbank.com>
Date: 2027-08-23 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production latency spike during quiet hours — urgent evidence request

Vivek,

We saw a sharp latency and error-rate spike in prod during our quiet window last night (roughly 02:15–02:45 UTC). Throughput dropped on several routes and our ops team saw ~6% client-facing errors for affected endpoints. Our CTO wants a short exec summary plus all evidence we can provide for an internal postmortem and a regulatory audit. Specifically we need:

- Per-shard latency histograms and error rates for 02:00–03:00 UTC
- Raw request traces (full headers allowed, please flag any PII)
- KV cache snapshot and any indicators of cache churn or eviction events
- Confirmation of retention windows for the runtime logs and whether any customer payloads are persisted beyond ephemeral caches
- Chain-of-custody / integrity proof for any artifacts you hand us (hashes, signed manifests)

Can you confirm what you can preserve today, how soon we can get an evidence bundle, and whether Redwood can provide a redacted copy suitable for sharing with our audit team? Also flag if any artifacts require a legal hold before you transport them.

Thanks — Rajiv
Rajiv Menon
VP, Infrastructure — Cardinal Bank
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@cardinalbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production latency spike during quiet hours — urgent evidence request

Rajiv —

Thanks for the heads up. We’ve initiated evidence preservation and will treat this as an incident escalation. Immediate notes and next steps:

- Preservation: We’ve snapshot and frozen telemetry for 02:00–03:00 UTC. Karthik is pulling the telemetry and traces to a secured bucket and will create a signed manifest.
- What we will provide: latency histograms, error-rate breakdown by route, request traces (PII redaction option), KV-cache snapshot (encrypted), and an integrity manifest containing SHA256 hashes and an HMAC.
- Legal hold: Lauren, can you confirm if Cardinal requires a formal preservation notice from Redwood? We’ll hold data until we get direction but will prepare transfer-ready artifacts.
- Timeline: initial evidence bundle (redacted set + manifest) by EOD your time today; full forensic package by tomorrow noon PT subject to legal review.

I’ll follow up once Karthik shares the exact artifact names and secure links. If exec-level sync would help, we can schedule a short call today — propose 11:00 PT.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Evidence collection plan for Cardinal — urgent

Team — collecting everything we can for Cardinal’s audit and execs. Please action below: 

Karthik:
- Pull telemetry slices for 2027-08-23T02:00:00Z -> 2027-08-23T03:00:00Z. Include per-shard latency histograms, per-route QPS, 5xx/4xx rates, and scheduler/backpressure metrics.
- Export request traces for affected routes (trace IDs: collect from 02:12–02:27 UTC window). Redact Authorization/PII fields by default but produce an unredacted copy in the sealed bucket (encrypted) if Legal signs off.
- Create a KV-cache snapshot and note eviction events; include metadata about the model version, sequence length distribution, and exact node IDs.
- Produce an evidence_manifest_{timestamp}.txt with filenames, SHA256 hashes, collection times, and the collector’s username. Sign manifest with the incident HMAC key.

Marissa:
- Coordinate customer comms and confirm whether Cardinal wants an interim executive note (1 pager) or the full bundle today. Collect sample user prompt(s) they are comfortable sharing for our triage.

Lauren:
- Do we need a formal preservation notice / legal hold before transferring encrypted artifacts to Cardinal? If so, we’ll hold and provide an access token only to the incident mailbox. Also advise on any export controls for KV cache (possible sensitive tokens).

Keep threads internal here until we have a redacted package. Karthik — mark artifacts as restricted and put them in s3://redwood-secure/incidents/cardinal/2027-08-23/ with server-side encryption.

— Vivek
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Collected artifacts and transfer plan (Cardinal)

Folks — quick update on artifacts collected and their locations. All artifacts are ACL-restricted and encrypted at rest. Transfer will be via a secure, time-limited share link. Manifest will include hashes. Attachments below are stubs (we will not move raw tar in this email).

Collected artifacts (stubs):
- runtime_metrics_20270823_0215-0245.tar.gz (s3://redwood-secure/incidents/cardinal/2027-08-23/runtime_metrics_20270823_0215-0245.tar.gz) — contains per-shard histograms and scheduler metrics.
- request_traces_20270823_redacted.jsonl (s3://redwood-secure/incidents/cardinal/2027-08-23/request_traces_20270823_redacted.jsonl) — default redacted copy. Unredacted copy sealed: request_traces_20270823_unredacted.jsonl.enc
- kv_cache_snapshot_20270823.enc (s3://redwood-secure/incidents/cardinal/2027-08-23/kv_cache_snapshot_20270823.enc) — AES-256 encrypted; access requires KMS token and approval.
- evidence_manifest_20270823_1242.txt (attached to sealed bucket) — includes SHA256 for each file and HMAC signature.

Notes:
- Retention: By policy, runtime telemetry is retained 90 days; we are prepared to extend retention for incident artifacts for Cardinal to meet audit needs. Lauren — advise on official extension request format.
- Chain-of-custody: manifest will record collection host, collector user, UTC timestamp, and SHA256. We’ll also include an audit log export of actions (who accessed the bucket and when).
- PII: redaction rules applied to request_traces_20270823_redacted.jsonl (headers masked: Authorization and cookies removed; user identifiers hashed).

Planned delivery: I will place the sealed package in the secure drive and send a time-limited download link once Lauren confirms legal clearance for transfer (or Cardinal signs the preservation notice). Estimated ETA: 3–4 hours after clearance.

— Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@cardinalbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, ThirdParty Audit <audit@thirdparty-audit.com>
Date: 2027-08-24 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Delivering interim evidence bundle & next steps (Cardinal)

Rajiv —

Attached is the interim evidence bundle we discussed. Items in the bundle (redacted set):
- runtime_metrics_20270823_0215-0245.tar.gz (per-shard histograms, scheduler metrics)
- request_traces_20270823_redacted.jsonl (PII redacted)
- evidence_manifest_20270824.txt (SHA256 hashes + HMAC signature)

Location: https://drive.redwood.example/shared/cardinal-bank/incident-20270823 (time-limited, access logs enabled).

Notes and next steps:
- Secure copy of unredacted traces and encrypted KV snapshot are sealed and will be released only after a signed preservation notice or a mutually agreed legal process. Lauren is preparing the preservation language; she can loop in Cardinal legal.
- We extended retention for the incident bucket to 180 days to accommodate your audit request.
- For exec consumption we’ve prepared a one-page summary of impact and mitigation; Marissa will send it to your team in the next hour.
- If Cardinal would like an independent third-party to validate hashes and chain-of-custody, we can facilitate a read-only auditor access (we’ve cc’d ThirdParty Audit).

If you’d like to go through the artifacts live, propose a 30 minute call tomorrow at 09:00 PT.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
